tools.name: search_skills
tools.description: Search Qumge's curated catalog of agent skills (SKILL.md files) by what the user wants to accomplish. Use this whenever the user asks for a skill, tool, or capability — e.g. 'find me a skill for social media automation', 'is there a skill for SEO audits'. Returns the best few, ranked by how useful t

tools.name: get_skill
tools.description: Fetch the full SKILL.md content of one skill, by the slug returned from search_skills. Write the returned markdown to .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md (or the equivalent for the user's agent). If the reply says the skill ships more files (REFERENCE.md, scripts/…), call again with include_files: true t

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the skill categories and how many skills are in each. Useful when the user is browsing rather than looking for something specific.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List the models this gateway can route to, best first. Every one is reachable with the same Qumge key — no per-vendor signup. Only tool-calling models are listed: an agent cannot use the others.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: become_developer, verify_domain, publish_cap, cap_status · Private data: search_skills, get_skill, verify_domain, publish_cap, test_cap, submit_cap, get_earnings · Public sink: publish_cap, submit_cap · Destructive: test_cap, submit_cap.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: become_developer, verify_domain, publish_cap, cap_status · Private data: search_skills, get_skill, verify_domain, publish_cap, test_cap, submit_cap, get_earnings · Public sink: publish_cap, submit_cap · Destructive: test_cap, submit_cap

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_skill" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

Write the returned markdown to .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md (or the equivalent for the user's agent) and it is installed — no other step is needed." → after: "Fetch the full SKILL.md content of one skill, by the slug returned from search_skills. Write the returned markdown to .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md (or the equivalent for the user's agent). If the reply says the skill ships more files (REFERENCE.md, scripts/…), call again with include_files: true t"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
